name: Emery Rogers
life: “I still remember digging after dusk so a tree wouldn't dry out.” Sunday often includes a stop at the brick passage off the shop row, where Emery takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I am the neighbor who has enjoyed that garden without lifting a finger. I offered my ground for two of the trees.
appearance: Emery is easy to recognize by black hair twisted into a small knot and a round face with a pronounced chin. Usually dressed in a red windbreaker with one loose pocket corner secured with green thread, Emery counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices when listening.
personality: Emery finds names easy and faces hard on a crowded street. People who assume they have been snubbed usually get a warmer greeting once they speak.
agenda: To offer soil for the threatened trees.
family: Adrian Roche is Emery’s younger relative by marriage. Emery offers the first invitation. Adrian gets to change the plan. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The missing Sunday*, Adrian says, “I took my baby to visit and got tossed out at halftime for being too loud.”
connections: Kai Gross. The tenant's trees have an actual place to go because a neighbor offers some ground.
